checks.name: new migration is additive and repeated migration preserves recorded checksums
apex serves the real landing and email forms without exposing merchant data
registration rejects foreign origins, tenant Hosts and privileged body fields
email accounts persist hashed credentials and fixed host-only sessions
shop creation verifies CSRF and password before initializing native tenant resources
identical opening and repeated sample requests remain idempotent
a sibling account cannot list or modify another shop or submit a chosen tenant
client opening keys are namespaced by account and reserved slugs do not consume shop slots
concurrent opening requests cannot exceed the three-shop account limit
published samples appear through the tenant storefront catalog
clearing samples preserves ordinary products even if their metadata imitates a demo marker
paused shops reject sample writes and maintain owner-only native access
login failure is uniform and logout invalidates the saved session
account revocation and version changes are checked on every portal request
demo bootstrap uses dedicated accounts and keeps credentials in private files
demo merchant opens a sample shop and native quick login is limited to its bound owner
platform demo uses a separate administrator and public signup never grants that identity
demo logins disappear when disabled and are rejected for production or custom public domains
runtime grants cannot modify account privileges and schema drift blocks startup
